closed.includes: Body with the front input tray folded up and the top output tray closed (BP2300 series user guide 'product size' 337 x 220 x 179 mm)

printing.includes: front door folded down as the feeder tray (15 cm in front at shelf level) + output flap flipped forward out of the top

refill.includes: front door folded down as the feeder tray; paper is loaded onto it

weight_kg.what: without packaging, with the supplied (starter) toner cartridge

connectivity.details: USB 2.0; IEEE802.3 10/100Base-Tx Ethernet; 2.4/5 GHz dual-band Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n; Bluetooth (for app setup); Wi-Fi Direct (printer hotspot)

paper.input_type: front fold-down input tray (the lower front panel opens; paper sticks out in front)

power.type: C13 (IEC kettle plug, straight cord in the box; C14 inlet mounted vertically)
power.position: lower back, in the corner pillar at the printer's right end: 2.1 cm from the left edge seen from behind, centre 3.1 cm up
power.note: only a 0.5 cm frame; the plug (~3.4 cm) and strain relief stick straight out before the cord bends down

data.type: RJ45 Ethernet (USB-B just below it in the same pocket; Wi-Fi also available)
data.position: same corner pillar: 1.35 cm from the left edge seen from behind, RJ45 centre 12.9 cm up, USB-B centre 9.7 cm up
data.note: shallow framed pocket; the plug sticks out ~2.5 cm. Not needed if the printer is used over Wi-Fi

cable_space.why: Flat back with only shallow socket frames, so the straight C13 mains plug adds to the depth: the user's 'sticks out' case (5-8 cm). The build measures 6.4 cm from the back face to the cord bend.
cable_space.source: official rear drawing, BP2300 Series User Guide EN V1.4 p.2 (photo 14); real BP2300W port close-up https://altv-media.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com/2025/03/13235742/Pantum-BP2300W-Review-5.jpg (photo 22); hitechcentury BP2300W back (photo 12). No real photo of the power inlet was found: its position is from the manual drawing.
